entries.title: Submitters on full-page profiles
entries.summary: assigned record owners now appear in the **Submitters** row on contact and session full-page profiles, not only in the slide-over sidebar.

entries.title: Visit consent picker lists every contact field
entries.summary: the optional consent gate on a Visit mapping now offers every updatable contact field (portal-bound first), not only fields already placed on a portal form, plus form submissions and Config Set tasks.

entries.title: Visit Session ID on synced sessions
entries.summary: when you push sessions as Visit activities, Sessionboard creates a read-only **Visit Session ID** field and fills it with the Visit activity id. The control reads **Set by Visit**.

entries.title: Embed search includes sub-sessions
entries.summary: searching a schedule or session embed also matches sub-session titles and sub-session participants (every role the embed is set to display). The parent session is what surfaces.

entries.title: Magic-link offer for first-time portal users
entries.summary: when password and magic link are both on, people who have never signed in also see **Or, email me a sign-in link**.

entries.title: Email frequency per organization and event
entries.summary: the notification preferences you are looking at now carry their own **Email frequency**, so one organization or a single event can run on immediate emails while the rest of your account stays on the daily summary. The control names the setting in force, and **Use account default** clears an override — including one set from an event's portal preference centre, which previously could not be undone from the admin app.

entries.title: Length limits stop the step, not the submit
entries.summary: an answer outside a text question's minimum or maximum now blocks the step it sits on, naming the field and the limit, so submitters fix it as they go instead of meeting a wall of errors on Submit.
